fields.duties:
FieldAI’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field.


FieldAI is seeking an Account Executive to drive growth within the construction industry by helping customers adopt autonomous robotics solutions that improve project execution, operational visibility, productivity, and safety.
This role will focus on developing relationships with General Contractors, Owners, and other key construction stakeholders, identifying opportunities to solve real-world operational challenges, and driving new business growth. You will work closely with customers, technical teams, and deployment teams to bring innovative technology into complex construction environments.
The ideal candidate understands how construction projects operate, has experience selling solutions used in the field, and is comfortable navigating complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.


What You'll Do
Develop and grow relationships with General Contractors, Owners, Developers, and other construction industry stakeholders
Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities
Lead complex sales cycles from initial engagement through contract execution
Partner closely with technical and deployment teams to align FieldAI solutions with customer needs
Build strategic account plans that drive long-term customer growth and expansion
Represent FieldAI at customer sites, industry events, and key customer meetings
Maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently deliver against revenue objectives

What You Bring
3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience
Experience selling into construction organizations, including General Contractors, Owners, Developers, or similar stakeholders
Track record of closing large, complex deals involving multiple decision-makers
Strong understanding of construction workflows, project stakeholders, and operational challenges
Excellent communication, relationship-building, and consultative selling skills
Ability to travel regularly and work closely with customers onsite

What Sets You Apart
Experience selling construction technology, robotics, automation, or other solutions used directly in field operations and project execution
Existing relationships within the construction industry
Experience partnering with technical, implementation, or deployment teams throughout the customer lifecycle
Passion for helping customers adopt innovative technologies that transform how work gets done

Our salary range is generous and we consider each individual’s background and experience when determining final compensation. Base pay may vary based on role scope, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the Irvine, California market.
 
Why Join FieldAI in Irvine?
In Irvine, you will work where the robots are. Our local team builds and tests systems on real hardware with real sensors, then ships them to operate in unstructured, previously unknown environments around the world. We are solving one of robotics’ hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.
You will collaborate with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring deep experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, along with a track record of field deployments and strong performance in DARPA challenge segments.
 
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
We are looking for builders who want their work to leave the whiteboard and show up on robots. If you enjoy tackling tough, uncharted questions and working across disciplines, you will find your people here. Our teams span AI, software, robotics engineering, product, field deployment, and technical communication, all focused on shipping systems that perform in the real world.
 
Our headquarters is in Irvine, and we partner closely with teams there as well as colleagues across the US and around the world. Join us in Southern California and help define what dependable, field-ready autonomy looks like.
 
We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We evaluate candidates and employees based on merit, qualifications, and performance, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

title: 高级海外整合营销经理

fields.duties:
岗位职责
岗位概述：
负责公司产品在重点海外市场的营销建设、市场进入策略与增长。你将作为海外业务的营销引擎，深度理解全球机器人产业格局与本地用户，将领先技术转化为清晰、有力的市场叙事，驱动产品上市与市场份额提升。
岗位职责：
1、制定并执行所负责海外市场的年度整合营销策略、预算及落地计划，对市场占有率及品牌知名度目标负责。
2、主导海外产品GTM全流程，包括市场洞察、定位、渠道规划及销售工具赋能。
管理与优化海外数字营销矩阵（网站、社交媒体、SEO/SEM、邮件等），通过数据分析持续提升获客效率与转化率。
3、负责海外内容运营，策划传播内容，管理代理商，塑造行业技术领导力与可信赖的品牌形象。
4、深度协同海外销售、渠道伙伴及公司内部产品、研发团队，确保营销活动精准支撑业务目标。

任职要求
1、硬性要求：英语可作为工作语言；拥有5年及以上科技硬件、机器人、AI或SaaS领域的海外营销经验。
2、经验与技能：有完整的海外市场0-1或1-10营销实战经验；精通海外主流数字营销与社交媒体平台运营；具备出色的数据分析与策略复盘能力。
3、行业认知：对机器人、人工智能或智能硬件行业有深刻兴趣与洞察，了解全球科技媒体与生态。
4、个人特质：目标导向，具备卓越的跨文化沟通能力、项目推动力与创业公司所需的强自驱力

岗位职责
一、岗位概述
负责公司品牌公关、官方舆论传播，核心维护央媒/党媒核心媒体渠道，输出贴合硬科技、具身智能赛道的官方内容，搭建企业权威公众形象，支撑公司政企传播、行业发声及舆情管理。

二、岗位职责
- 核心对接：维护央媒/党媒采编及管理层资源，完成日常沟通、选题申报、专访落地；
- 内容传播：统筹企业官方稿件、深度报道、高管专访内容策划与输出，适配主流官媒传播调性；
- 事件公关：负责产品发布、技术亮相、政企活动的媒体邀约、现场传播及复盘；
- 舆情管理：监测行业及企业舆情，联动官媒渠道做好正面引导、风险对冲；

Boston Dynamics is the world leader in mobile robotics, solving the hardest problems in the field – and with Atlas, building the most capable humanoid robot on the planet. For years, our awe-inspiring viral videos on YouTube have shown the world what remarkably capable robots can do. Today that vision is moving out of the lab and into the real economy: Spot and Stretch are already deployed across the world's largest factories, warehouses, and energy sites, and Atlas is on the path to joining them.
We are seeking a highly accomplished, results-driven
Staff Strategy Analyst
to join our Strategy team, reporting directly to the Director of Strategy Analytics. This is a rare opportunity to sit at the center of the decision-making engine of the company bringing the humanoid revolution out of the lab and into the real economy. You will own the analyses, models, and narratives that go directly to the CEO and Board, and you will watch your work translate into real product, commercial, and capital allocation decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Analysis & Modeling:
Lead the development of complex business and financial models – long-range forecasts, market sizing, M&A and corporate development cases, capital allocation, unit economics, and cost / margin optimization – to evaluate strategic options and quantify their financial impact.
Design and execute quantitative analyses across market trends, competitive dynamics, and internal performance drivers, and turn them into a clear point of view
Business Storytelling & Communication:
Translate complex analytical findings into clear and compelling narratives for senior leadership and Board-level audiences.
Own the end-to-end build of executive presentations – from structure to slide craft – ensuring the story and the visuals are both at a top-tier standard.
Cross-Functional Execution:
Drive strategic initiatives end-to-end, partnering closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Operations, and the business unit GMs. A large share of the impact in this role comes from orchestrating work across these teams and pulling the right people in at the right moments.
Develop and track the KPIs and operating metrics.
Physical AI & Technology Lens:
Serve as an internal thought partner on emerging trends in robotics, AI, and automation, and how they reshape the opportunity set for Boston Dynamics.
Provide strategic input into technology investments, product roadmaps, and partnership decisions.
Required Qualifications
Experience
: 3+ years of progressive experience top-tier management consulting (e.g., MBB), investment banking, private equity, or corporate development.
Modeling Proficiency
: Exceptional proficiency in Excel, including advanced financial modeling, scenario analysis, and the discipline to build models that hold up under executive scrutiny.
Data & Market Research
: Strong ability to gather and synthesize a wide range of sources – company financials, end-user usage data, industry reports, expert interviews – into a defensible point of view.
Communication
: Demonstrated excellence in written and verbal communication, with the ability to structure and deliver persuasive arguments and visually impactful presentations to senior audiences.
Cross-Functional Operating Style
: Track record of operating effectively across functions and earning trust quickly with senior stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
Industry Experience
: Prior experience in the technology, robotics, or industrials sectors, or advising clients in those sectors.
Corporate Finance Depth
: Comfort with valuation, capital structure, and full three-statement modeling.
Corporate Development / M&A Experience
: Prior exposure to deal sourcing, diligence, or integration – buy-side or sell-side.
Education
: MBA or advanced degree from a top-tier institution.
We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.
The base pay range for this position is between $101,545.95 to $126,932.44 annually. Comfort working in fast-paced, evolving environments

Interest in technology, startups, and building something from zero to one

岗位职责
1、技术传播策略：围绕GO系列基座模型、GE-Sim世界模型、Genie Evolver真机强化学习系统等核心技术，制定年度技术传播策略与叙事主线，策划技术里程碑的传播节奏；
2、技术内容产出：负责技术发布稿、深度技术解读、论文与开源成果传播、专利与奖项包装等内容的策划与撰写，把论文、代码和参数变成行业听得懂、愿意转的故事；
3、研发协同机制：与算法、仿真、产品团队建立常态化内容共创机制，深入研发一线挖掘技术卖点，确保传播内容的技术准确性，管理对外技术参数口径；
4、技术活动传播：支持技术发布会、开发者大会、行业展会（WAIC/WRC等）的技术内容策划，以及顶会（CoRL/ICRA/RSS等）学术成果的传播放大；
5、开发者生态传播：运营GitHub、Hugging Face、技术社区的开源项目传播，策划面向开发者群体的技术内容（解读文章、教程、直播），提升技术品牌的社区影响力；
6、技术舆情管理：监测技术类舆情与竞品技术叙事，制定技术争议（如参数对比、评测结果质疑）的应对口径。

任职要求
任职要求
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、人工智能、机器人、自动化等相关专业背景，或3年以上科技媒体技术记者/编辑经验；
2、3年以上技术传播、技术营销或技术内容相关经验，有AI/机器人行业从业经历者优先；
3、能读懂论文——理解VLA大模型、强化学习、世界模型、Sim2Real等技术概念，能与算法工程师平等对话；
4、写作功底扎实，有技术解读、深度稿件的代表作，能把复杂技术写得准确又好看；
5、对技术趋势有判断力，能预判哪些技术点有传播价值；
6、英语读写能力强，能处理英文技术内容（顶会、开源社区、海外传播场景）；
7、强跨部门协同能力，能推动研发团队配合传播节奏。

What we’re doing isn’t easy, but nothing worth doing ever is.
We envision a future powered by robots that work seamlessly with human teams. We build artificial intelligence that enables service robots to collaborate with people and adapt to dynamic human environments. Join our mission-driven, venture-backed team as we build out current and future generations of humanoid robots.
Field-based · ~75% travel · Preference for candidates near a major airport
About the Role
The Client Success Manager owns the health, performance, and growth of a hospital or territory of hospital partners running Moxi robot fleets. You are both the executive relationship owner and the operator behind the numbers: you run leadership check-ins and quarterly business reviews, translate utilization data into a clear story about value delivered, and drive the projects that resolve issues and lift site performance.
Priorities shift, sites behave differently, and the playbook is still being written. The CSMs who thrive here make good decisions with incomplete information and move fast without losing rigor.
What You'll Be Doing
Own executive relationships and the value narrative
Serve as the trusted executive contact for each hospital — C-suite sponsors, nursing leadership, and operational stakeholders.
Lead recurring leadership check-ins and quarterly business reviews: set the agenda, build the deck, present performance against goals, and close with documented decisions, owners, and next steps.
Communicate Moxi's value in each stakeholder's terms — clinical hours returned, delivery volume, staff satisfaction, cost avoidance — continuously, not just at renewal.
Use data to drive better outcomes
Monitor utilization, adoption, and reliability data across your territory; know each site's baseline, trends, and outliers.
Diagnose
why
a site underperforms, run the intervention, and measure whether it worked.
Set and track site-level performance targets with partners, and report on progress honestly in every leadership conversation.
Surface cross-account patterns that should shape product priorities and playbooks.
Project manage to drive down issues and lift performance
Run a prioritized book of work per account — open issues, improvement projects, use case activations — with clear owners, dates, and status visible internally and to the client.
Drive issue resolution end to end: intake, triage, escalation, resolution, and closing the loop.
Coordinate operations, support, engineering, product, and growth to unblock sites, without direct authority over any of them.
Grow adoption and expand the footprint
Partner with clinical teams on staff training, workflow fit, and creative solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.
Discover, prioritize, and activate new use cases; maintain use case libraries and account action plans, aligned to new product releases.
Work with operations and growth to identify fleet expansion opportunities and supply the performance evidence that makes the case.
Operate as a Diligent teammate
Manage client success operations across multiple hospitals in your territory, contribute to colleagues' development and the client success playbook, and drive outcomes that ladder up to company OKRs.
What You'll Need
Comfort in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
— you adapt when priorities change, operate without a finished playbook, and stay organized when several sites need you at once.
Data fluency

What we’re doing isn’t easy, but nothing worth doing ever is.
We envision a future powered by robots that work seamlessly with human teams. We build artificial intelligence that enables service robots to collaborate with people and adapt to dynamic human environments. Join our mission-driven, venture-backed team as we build out current and future generations of humanoid robots.
Field-based · ~75% travel · Preference for candidates near a major airport
About the Role
The Client Success Manager owns the health, performance, and growth of a hospital or territory of hospital partners running Moxi robot fleets. You are both the executive relationship owner and the operator behind the numbers: you run leadership check-ins and quarterly business reviews, translate utilization data into a clear story about value delivered, and drive the projects that resolve issues and lift site performance.
Priorities shift, sites behave differently, and the playbook is still being written. The CSMs who thrive here make good decisions with incomplete information and move fast without losing rigor.
What You'll Be Doing
Own executive relationships and the value narrative
Serve as the trusted executive contact for each hospital — C-suite sponsors, nursing leadership, and operational stakeholders.
Lead recurring leadership check-ins and quarterly business reviews: set the agenda, build the deck, present performance against goals, and close with documented decisions, owners, and next steps.
Communicate Moxi's value in each stakeholder's terms — clinical hours returned, delivery volume, staff satisfaction, cost avoidance — continuously, not just at renewal.
Use data to drive better outcomes
Monitor utilization, adoption, and reliability data across your territory; know each site's baseline, trends, and outliers.
Diagnose
why
a site underperforms, run the intervention, and measure whether it worked.
Set and track site-level performance targets with partners, and report on progress honestly in every leadership conversation.
Surface cross-account patterns that should shape product priorities and playbooks.
Project manage to drive down issues and lift performance
Run a prioritized book of work per account — open issues, improvement projects, use case activations — with clear owners, dates, and status visible internally and to the client.
Drive issue resolution end to end: intake, triage, escalation, resolution, and closing the loop.
Coordinate operations, support, engineering, product, and growth to unblock sites, without direct authority over any of them.
Grow adoption and expand the footprint
Partner with clinical teams on staff training, workflow fit, and creative solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.
Discover, prioritize, and activate new use cases; maintain use case libraries and account action plans, aligned to new product releases.
Work with operations and growth to identify fleet expansion opportunities and supply the performance evidence that makes the case.
Operate as a Diligent teammate
Manage client success operations across multiple hospitals in your territory, contribute to colleagues' development and the client success playbook, and drive outcomes that ladder up to company OKRs.
